## Specification

### Component: Tooltip

Short supporting text for a control. Opens on hover after a delay and on keyboard focus; never from touch. The bubble is a `popover="manual"` element in the top layer, positioned by `useFloating` through the shared `FloatingContent`.

#### Anatomy
```
<TooltipProvider>               shared delay + "skip delay" window (optional; defaults apply without it)
  <Tooltip>                     context: open state, ids, timers
    <TooltipTrigger />          button (or asChild): aria-describedby while open
    <TooltipContent>            <div class="ui-floating ui-tooltip" role="tooltip" popover="manual" data-state data-side>
      text
      <kbd class="ui-tooltip-kbd">   optional, from the `shortcut` prop
```

#### Props
- `TooltipProvider`: `delayDuration` (700ms), `skipDelayDuration` (300ms).
- `Tooltip`: `open`, `defaultOpen`, `onOpenChange`, `delayDuration` (per-tooltip override).
- `TooltipContent`: `placement` (default `top`), `align`, `offset` (6), `shortcut`, native div props.
- `TooltipTrigger`: `asChild`.

#### Behaviour
- Pointer (mouse/pen, never touch): `pointerenter` starts the delay timer; `pointerleave` closes after a 100ms grace so the pointer can reach the bubble (hoverable content, WCAG 1.4.13). `pointerdown` closes it.
- Skip window: when another tooltip of the provider is open, or one closed less than `skipDelayDuration` ago, the next one opens with no delay. Opening a tooltip closes the other one.
- Keyboard: focus opens it immediately only when the focus is `:focus-visible` (keyboard), not after a pointer click; blur closes it.
- Esc closes it (also when only hovering); the trigger handles Esc first so an enclosing popover stays open. Scrolling closes it (ignored for 200ms after opening, because focusing can scroll the trigger into view).
- Flips to the opposite side when there is no room; shifts to stay inside the viewport.

#### Visual rules
- Inverted bubble: `--ui-foreground` fill, `--ui-background` text, `--radius-md`, padding 6px 10px, 12px/500 text, `--ui-shadow-md`, max width 20rem.
- Shortcut: small mono key chip, `color-mix(--ui-background 18%, transparent)` fill.

#### Motion
- Open: `ui-pop-in` 150ms `--ui-ease-out` from the trigger side, 3px travel, scale .96.
- Close: `ui-pop-out` 100ms `--ui-ease-in`.

#### Accessibility
- `role="tooltip"`; trigger `aria-describedby` points at it only while it is rendered.
- Not the only way to learn something essential; never opens from touch.

#### Acceptance checks
- Hover opens after ~700ms, not before; Tab opens at once; a mouse click on the button does not open it.
- Moving between toolbar buttons quickly opens the next tooltip with no delay.
- Esc, pointer leave and scroll close it; the bubble sits next to the trigger and flips near the edge.
- No axe violations in light and dark.

### `ui/components/tooltip/tooltip.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  createContext,
  forwardRef,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useId,
  useMemo,
  useRef,
  type ButtonHTMLAttributes,
  type FocusEvent,
  type KeyboardEvent,
  type PointerEvent,
  type ReactNode,
  type RefObject,
} from 'react';
import { Slot } from '../../lib/slot';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useComposedRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { useDismiss } from '../../hooks/use-dismiss';
import { useHoverIntent } from '../../hooks/use-hover-intent';
import { FloatingContent, type FloatingContentProps } from '../popover/floating-content';

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/** Which tooltip is open and when one last closed, shared by every tooltip in a provider. */
interface Registry {
  active: { id: string; close: () => void } | null;
  lastClosed: number;
}

interface ProviderValue {
  delayDuration: number;
  skipDelayDuration: number;
  registry: Registry;
}

const ProviderContext = createContext<ProviderValue>({
  delayDuration: 700,
  skipDelayDuration: 300,
  registry: { active: null, lastClosed: 0 },
});

export interface TooltipProviderProps {
  /** Hover delay before a tooltip opens, ms. Default 700. */
  delayDuration?: number;
  /**
   * After a tooltip closes, moving to another one within this window opens it
   * with no delay (scanning a toolbar). ms. Default 300.
   */
  skipDelayDuration?: number;
  children?: ReactNode;
}

/** Shares the hover delay and the "skip delay" window between tooltips. Wrap a toolbar or the whole app. */
export function TooltipProvider({ delayDuration = 700, skipDelayDuration = 300, children }: TooltipProviderProps) {
  const registry = useRef<Registry>({ active: null, lastClosed: 0 });
  const value = useMemo(
    () => ({ delayDuration, skipDelayDuration, registry: registry.current }),
    [delayDuration, skipDelayDuration],
  );
  return <ProviderContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</ProviderContext.Provider>;
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

const CLOSE_GRACE = 100;

interface TooltipContextValue {
  open: boolean;
  contentId: string;
  triggerRef: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
  /** Open after the hover delay (none inside the skip window). */
  scheduleOpen: () => void;
  /** Close after a short grace so the pointer can travel onto the bubble. */
  scheduleClose: () => void;
  openNow: () => void;
  closeNow: () => void;
  cancel: () => void;
}

const TooltipContext = createContext<TooltipContextValue | null>(null);

function useTooltipContext(component: string) {
  const ctx = useContext(TooltipContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error(`<${component}> must be used inside <Tooltip>.`);
  return ctx;
}

export interface TooltipProps {
  /** Controlled open state. */
  open?: boolean;
  /** Initial open state when uncontrolled. */
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
  /** Called when the tooltip asks to open or close. */
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
  /** Hover delay for this tooltip, ms. Defaults to the provider's. */
  delayDuration?: number;
  children?: ReactNode;
}

/**
 * Tooltip — short supporting text for a control. Opens on hover after a delay
 * and on keyboard focus; never from touch. The trigger gets aria-describedby.
 */
export function Tooltip({ open: openProp, defaultOpen = false, onOpenChange, delayDuration, children }: TooltipProps) {
  const provider = useContext(ProviderContext);
  const registry = provider.registry;
  const [open, setOpen] = useControllableState({ value: openProp, defaultValue: defaultOpen, onChange: onOpenChange });
  const id = useId();
  const triggerRef = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const intent = useHoverIntent();

  // Register while open so other tooltips can close this one and skip their delay
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    registry.active = { id, close: () => setOpen(false) };
    return () => {
      if (registry.active?.id === id) registry.active = null;
      registry.lastClosed = Date.now();
    };
  }, [open, registry, id, setOpen]);

  const openNow = useCallback(() => {
    intent.cancel();
    const other = registry.active;
    if (other && other.id !== id) other.close();
    setOpen(true);
  }, [intent, registry, id, setOpen]);

  const closeNow = useCallback(() => {
    intent.cancel();
    setOpen(false);
  }, [intent, setOpen]);

  const scheduleOpen = useCallback(() => {
    const warm =
      (registry.active !== null && registry.active.id !== id) ||
      Date.now() - registry.lastClosed < provider.skipDelayDuration;
    intent.start(openNow, warm ? 0 : (delayDuration ?? provider.delayDuration));
  }, [intent, registry, id, provider, delayDuration, openNow]);

  const scheduleClose = useCallback(() => intent.start(closeNow, CLOSE_GRACE), [intent, closeNow]);

  // Esc closes it (also when only hovering); scrolling closes it too
  useDismiss(open, [], closeNow, { outside: false });
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const openedAt = Date.now();
    // Focusing a button can scroll it into view; that scroll must not close the tooltip it just opened
    const onScroll = () => {
      if (Date.now() - openedAt > 200) closeNow();
    };
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { capture: true, passive: true });
    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { capture: true });
  }, [open, closeNow]);

  return (
    <TooltipContext.Provider
      value={{
        open,
        contentId: `${id}-content`,
        triggerRef,
        scheduleOpen,
        scheduleClose,
        openNow,
        closeNow,
        cancel: intent.cancel,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </TooltipContext.Provider>
  );
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/** Only keyboard focus opens a tooltip; a pointer click focuses the button too and must not. */
function isKeyboardFocus(el: HTMLElement) {
  try {
    return el.matches(':focus-visible');
  } catch {
    return true;
  }
}

export interface TooltipTriggerProps extends ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  asChild?: boolean;
}

/** The element that owns the tooltip. Use `asChild` to wrap your own <Button>. */
export const TooltipTrigger = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, TooltipTriggerProps>(function TooltipTrigger(
  { asChild, onPointerEnter, onPointerLeave, onPointerDown, onFocus, onBlur, onKeyDown, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const ctx = useTooltipContext('TooltipTrigger');
  const composed = useComposedRefs(ref, ctx.triggerRef as RefObject<HTMLButtonElement | null>);
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot : 'button';
  return (
    <Comp
      ref={composed}
      type={asChild ? undefined : 'button'}
      aria-describedby={ctx.open ? ctx.contentId : undefined}
      data-state={ctx.open ? 'open' : 'closed'}
      onPointerEnter={(e: PointerEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
        onPointerEnter?.(e);
        if (e.pointerType !== 'touch') ctx.scheduleOpen();
      }}
      onPointerLeave={(e: PointerEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
        onPointerLeave?.(e);
        ctx.scheduleClose();
      }}
      onPointerDown={(e: PointerEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
        onPointerDown?.(e);
        ctx.closeNow();
      }}
      onFocus={(e: FocusEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
        onFocus?.(e);
        if (isKeyboardFocus(e.currentTarget)) ctx.openNow();
      }}
      onBlur={(e: FocusEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
        onBlur?.(e);
        ctx.closeNow();
      }}
      onKeyDown={(e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
        onKeyDown?.(e);
        // Close the tooltip before anything else (a popover around it) reacts to Esc
        if (e.key === 'Escape' && ctx.open) {
          e.preventDefault();
          ctx.closeNow();
        }
      }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export interface TooltipContentProps
  extends Omit<
    FloatingContentProps,
    'open' | 'anchorRef' | 'arrow' | 'matchWidth' | 'onOpened' | 'returnFocusRef' | 'skipFocusReturnRef'
  > {
  /** A keyboard shortcut shown inside the bubble, e.g. "⌘B". */
  shortcut?: ReactNode;
}

export const TooltipContent = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, TooltipContentProps>(function TooltipContent(
  { placement = 'top', offset = 6, shortcut, className, children, onPointerEnter, onPointerLeave, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const ctx = useTooltipContext('TooltipContent');
  return (
    <FloatingContent
      ref={ref}
      open={ctx.open}
      anchorRef={ctx.triggerRef}
      placement={placement}
      offset={offset}
      role="tooltip"
      id={ctx.contentId}
      className={cn('ui-tooltip', className)}
      onPointerEnter={(e) => {
        onPointerEnter?.(e);
        ctx.cancel();
      }}
      onPointerLeave={(e) => {
        onPointerLeave?.(e);
        ctx.scheduleClose();
      }}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
      {shortcut != null && <kbd className="ui-tooltip-kbd">{shortcut}</kbd>}
    </FloatingContent>
  );
});
```

### `ui/hooks/use-controllable-state.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

/**
 * State that can be controlled (`value` + `onChange`) or uncontrolled
 * (`defaultValue`). Every stateful component uses this so the two modes
 * behave identically.
 */
export function useControllableState<T>({
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onChange,
}: {
  value?: T;
  defaultValue: T;
  onChange?: (value: T) => void;
}): [T, (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void] {
  const [internal, setInternal] = useState<T>(defaultValue);
  const controlled = value !== undefined;
  const current = controlled ? (value as T) : internal;
  const currentRef = useRef(current);
  currentRef.current = current;
  const onChangeRef = useRef(onChange);
  onChangeRef.current = onChange;

  const setValue = useCallback(
    (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => {
      const resolved = typeof next === 'function' ? (next as (prev: T) => T)(currentRef.current) : next;
      if (Object.is(resolved, currentRef.current)) return;
      currentRef.current = resolved;
      if (!controlled) setInternal(resolved);
      onChangeRef.current?.(resolved);
    },
    [controlled],
  );

  return [current, setValue];
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-dismiss.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef, type RefObject } from 'react';

export type DismissReason = 'escape' | 'outside';

/**
 * Call `onDismiss` on Escape or a pointerdown outside every element in `refs`.
 * Used by popovers, menus, selects — anything non-modal that floats.
 */
export function useDismiss(
  enabled: boolean,
  refs: RefObject<Element | null>[],
  onDismiss: (reason: DismissReason) => void,
  { escape = true, outside = true }: { escape?: boolean; outside?: boolean } = {},
) {
  const cb = useRef(onDismiss);
  cb.current = onDismiss;
  const refsRef = useRef(refs);
  refsRef.current = refs;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) return;
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (escape && e.key === 'Escape' && !e.defaultPrevented) {
        e.preventDefault();
        cb.current('escape');
      }
    };
    const onPointer = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      const target = e.target as Node | null;
      if (!target) return;
      if (refsRef.current.some((r) => r.current?.contains(target))) return;
      cb.current('outside');
    };
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    if (outside) document.addEventListener('pointerdown', onPointer, true);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
      document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', onPointer, true);
    };
  }, [enabled, escape, outside]);
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-hover-intent.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';

/**
 * One cancellable timer for hover intent (tooltip delays, submenu open/close).
 * Starting a new timer replaces the previous one; it is cleared on unmount.
 *   const intent = useHoverIntent();
 *   intent.start(() => setOpen(true), 700);   intent.cancel();
 */
export function useHoverIntent() {
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(undefined);

  const cancel = useCallback(() => {
    clearTimeout(timer.current);
    timer.current = undefined;
  }, []);

  const start = useCallback(
    (fn: () => void, delay: number) => {
      cancel();
      if (delay <= 0) {
        fn();
        return;
      }
      timer.current = setTimeout(() => {
        timer.current = undefined;
        fn();
      }, delay);
    },
    [cancel],
  );

  useEffect(() => cancel, [cancel]);

  return useMemo(() => ({ start, cancel }), [start, cancel]);
}
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/compose-refs.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, type Ref, type RefCallback } from 'react';

type PossibleRef<T> = Ref<T> | undefined;

function setRef<T>(ref: PossibleRef<T>, value: T | null) {
  if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(value);
  else if (ref) (ref as { current: T | null }).current = value;
}

/** Merge several refs into one callback ref. */
export function composeRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  return (node) => {
    for (const ref of refs) setRef(ref, node);
  };
}

/** Memoised composeRefs for use inside components. */
export function useComposedRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs);
}
```

### `ui/lib/slot.tsx`

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import {
  Children,
  cloneElement,
  forwardRef,
  isValidElement,
  type HTMLAttributes,
  type ReactElement,
  type ReactNode,
  type Ref,
} from 'react';
import { cn } from './cn';
import { composeRefs } from './compose-refs';

/**
 * Slot — renders its single child instead of its own element, merging props.
 * Powers `asChild`: <Button asChild><a href="/">Home</a></Button>.
 * Event handlers are chained (child first), className is joined, style merged.
 */
export interface SlotProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> {
  children?: ReactNode;
}

type AnyProps = Record<string, unknown>;

const LAZY = Symbol.for('react.lazy');

/**
 * In React Server Components, children passed into a client component can arrive
 * as lazy references. Unwrap them with React.use (React 19) before cloning.
 */
function resolveLazy(node: ReactNode): ReactNode {
  const maybe = node as { $$typeof?: symbol; _payload?: unknown } | null;
  const use = (React as unknown as { use?: (p: unknown) => ReactNode }).use;
  if (maybe && typeof maybe === 'object' && maybe.$$typeof === LAZY && typeof use === 'function') {
    return use(maybe._payload);
  }
  return node;
}

function mergeProps(slotProps: AnyProps, childProps: AnyProps): AnyProps {
  const merged: AnyProps = { ...slotProps, ...childProps };
  for (const key of Object.keys(slotProps)) {
    const slotValue = slotProps[key];
    const childValue = childProps[key];
    if (/^on[A-Z]/.test(key) && typeof slotValue === 'function' && typeof childValue === 'function') {
      merged[key] = (...args: unknown[]) => {
        (childValue as (...a: unknown[]) => void)(...args);
        (slotValue as (...a: unknown[]) => void)(...args);
      };
    } else if (key === 'className') {
      merged[key] = cn(slotValue as string, childValue as string);
    } else if (key === 'style') {
      merged[key] = { ...(slotValue as object), ...(childValue as object) };
    }
  }
  return merged;
}

export const Slot = forwardRef<HTMLElement, SlotProps>(function Slot({ children, ...props }, ref) {
  const child = resolveLazy(Children.only(resolveLazy(children) as ReactElement));
  if (!isValidElement(child)) return null;
  const element = child as ReactElement<AnyProps & { ref?: Ref<HTMLElement> }>;
  // React 19 exposes ref as a prop; React 18 keeps it on the element.
  const childRef = (element.props.ref ?? (element as unknown as { ref?: Ref<HTMLElement> }).ref) as Ref<HTMLElement> | undefined;
  return cloneElement(element, {
    ...mergeProps(props as AnyProps, element.props),
    ref: ref ? composeRefs(ref, childRef) : childRef,
  });
});
```

### `ui/styles/components/tooltip.css`

```css
/* Tooltip -----------------------------------------------------------------
   <div class="ui-floating ui-tooltip" role="tooltip" popover="manual" data-state data-side>
     text  <kbd class="ui-tooltip-kbd">⌘B</kbd>
   Inverted bubble: foreground fill, background text.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-tooltip {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    width: max-content;
    max-width: min(20rem, calc(100vw - 1rem));
    padding: 0.375rem 0.625rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background: var(--ui-foreground);
    color: var(--ui-background);
    box-shadow: var(--ui-shadow-md);
    font-size: var(--text-xs);
    line-height: 1rem;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  .ui-tooltip[data-side="bottom"] { --ui-pop-y: -3px; }
  .ui-tooltip[data-side="top"] { --ui-pop-y: 3px; }
  .ui-tooltip[data-state="open"] { animation: ui-pop-in var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-out) both; }
  .ui-tooltip[data-state="closed"] { animation: ui-pop-out var(--ui-duration-instant) var(--ui-ease-in) both; pointer-events: none; }

  .ui-tooltip-kbd {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    height: 1.125rem;
    padding-inline: 0.3125rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-background) 18%, transparent);
    color: var(--ui-background);
    font-family: var(--ui-font-mono);
    font-size: 0.6875rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 1;
  }
}
```

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

## Usage

**Toolbar tooltips** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/tooltip/toolbar.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
import { Button } from '@/ui/components/button';
import { Tooltip, TooltipContent, TooltipProvider, TooltipTrigger } from '@/ui/components/tooltip';
import { Icon, type IconName } from '@/ui/icons/icon';

const actions: { icon: IconName; label: string; shortcut: string }[] = [
  { icon: 'copy', label: 'Copy link', shortcut: '⌘L' },
  { icon: 'download', label: 'Download', shortcut: '⌘D' },
  { icon: 'star', label: 'Add to favourites', shortcut: '⌘S' },
  { icon: 'pencil', label: 'Rename', shortcut: 'F2' },
  { icon: 'trash', label: 'Move to trash', shortcut: '⌫' },
];

export default function TooltipToolbar() {
  return (
    <TooltipProvider>
      <div role="toolbar" aria-label="File actions" className="flex gap-1 rounded-lg border border-border bg-card p-1">
        {actions.map(({ icon, label, shortcut }) => (
          <Tooltip key={label}>
            <TooltipTrigger asChild>
              <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" icon aria-label={label}>

            </TooltipTrigger>
            <TooltipContent shortcut={shortcut}>{label}</TooltipContent>
          </Tooltip>

      </div>
    </TooltipProvider>
  );
```
